titre: Exercices — L'ordre des mots (word order) et la place de l'adverbe
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Place « always » : She ___ helps her mother.
corrige: Adverbe de fréquence avant le verbe ordinaire.

exercices.enonce: Remets dans l'ordre : yesterday / we / to the beach / went.
exercices.reponse: We went to the beach yesterday.

corrige: On ne sépare pas verbe et objet ; la manière vient après l'objet.

exercices.enonce: Place « often » : He ___ tired after school.
corrige: « He is often tired after school. »
exercices.reponse: He is often tired after school.

exercices.enonce: Remets dans l'ordre : carefully / the exercise / did / she.

corrige: Adverbe de fréquence avant le verbe.

exercices.enonce: Remets dans l'ordre : this morning / at the station / I / saw / her.
corrige: Lieu (at the station) avant temps (this morning).
exercices.reponse: I saw her at the station this morning.

exercices.enonce: Place « never » : I have ___ eaten sushi.
corrige: Avec un auxiliaire (have), l'adverbe se place juste après.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : She likes very much dogs.
corrige: On ne place rien entre le verbe et l'objet.

exercices.enonce: Remets dans l'ordre (SVOMPT) : every evening / a book / reads / in bed / quietly / she.
corrige: She + reads + a book + quietly + in bed + every evening.
exercices.reponse: She reads a book quietly in bed every evening.
